subject: Re: Kickoff: invariant explanations / meta-model audits
body: Status at the end of the heavy month. Full-zoo training is done for the X,H covariate setting: at train_fraction 0.8, the meta-model hits 87.9% test accuracy predicting base-model predictions, and accuracy is stable (±0.4) across the instance-split iterations — the invariance property we hoped to see. The X,W@epoch setting is running now; early epochs (≤10) barely beat X,H, which supports the cheap-covariates story for the audit tool. Per config.py conventions, every setup's train/test accuracy is saved out, so the aggregate plots regenerate automatically. Issues: the W@epoch extraction hit a snag — snapshot layouts differ across zoo generations, and Bilal lost most of a week normalizing them (this is the risk we flagged; his May allocation is what's absorbing it). The fast-scratch mirror from Corpus landed May 12 and I/O stopped being the bottleneck. On track for the June decision. — Linnea
